items.headline: $AKT Votes to Ditch Cosmos for Solana
items.summary: Akash opened Prop 346 to migrate from Cosmos to Solana with a one-way $AKT token conversion. Staking rewards would end at a later marketplace cutover.

items.headline: $OSMO Kills Inflation, Shifts to Revenue Rewards
items.summary: Osmosis ended $OSMO inflation, removing ~2 points of issuance-funded staking APR and freezing 51.9M pre-minted dev tokens. Stakers now earn from protocol revenue.

items.headline: Sony-Backed Soneium Plans Native Token Launch
items.summary: Sony's Soneium L2 is planning a native token as it pushes tokenized IP, with royalty-backed vaults and K-pop concert bonds in the pipeline. Early eyes on this one.

items.headline: $HYPE Taps Kraken Parent for Regulated US Perps
items.summary: Hyperliquid will make Kraken parent Payward the first CFTC-regulated HIP-3 deployer, testing permissioned markets for US perpetual futures on $HYPE's ecosystem.

items.headline: $X100 Exploiter Launders 420 ETH via Tornado
items.summary: The $X100 exploiter sent 420.8 ETH to Tornado Cash after the $4.85M governance-takeover hack. Four wallets still hold ~1,602 ETH.
